read.title: Re: Collaboration Terms
read.text:
Hi Chloe,

Thank you for sharing your rate card. We'd love to work with you on our winter moisturizer campaign.

Our budget for this campaign is $2,000 for one TikTok video and two Instagram Stories. Your listed rate is $2,600, so would you be flexible on the fee if we extend the posting window to three weeks?

We would also like a usage period of 60 days so that we can run your video as a paid ad. During the campaign, we ask for 14 days of exclusivity, which means no posts for other moisturizer brands.

Please let me know your thoughts.

Best,
Minsu
